comparison.objective: Candidate removes a fan; record counts nuts while transferring them and operating a tally counter.
comparison.physical_skill: Release-and-extract versus repeated singulation, one-at-a-time transfer, counter reset, and synchronized counting.
comparison.success_condition: One module removed safely versus all 11 nuts transferred, counter reading 11, no drops/order faults, released and stable.
comparison.reason: Counting-state synchronization and singulation are unrelated to the candidate's retained-module extraction.
